svg.title: Animal hearing frequency ranges
svg.desc: Approximate audible frequency ranges of selected vertebrates, grouped by taxonomic class. Logarithmic frequency scale. Sources: RR Fay 1988 (Hearing in Vertebrates: a Psychophysics Databook); D Warfield 1973; RR Fay and AN Popper 1994; CD West 1985; EA Lipman and JR Grassi 1942; HE Heffner 1983.
svg.text: Approximate audible frequencies of selected vertebrates · logarithmic scale
Data: Fay 1988; Warfield 1973; Fay & Popper 1994; West 1985; Lipman & Grassi 1942; Heffner 1983.
